app.heading: Tablely · Wholesale order tables
design.title: Design
design.appearanceHint: Styles are applied to the order table on your storefront and take effect immediately after saving.
design.brandColorHint: Used for the submit button and the keyboard focus outline. Leave empty to follow your theme's text color.
design.radiusHint: 0–24 pixels. Leave empty to use the default.
design.densityHint: Controls the padding inside table rows.
design.fontHint: Following the theme is the most compatible choice.
design.taxDisplayHint: How prices are shown in relation to tax.
design.outOfStockHint: What customers see for variants that cannot be ordered.
design.feedbackStyleHint: Where add-to-cart results appear after submitting.
design.hideNative: Hide the theme's own add-to-cart section
design.hideNativeHint: Off by default. The switch is ignored automatically when the order table is not shown.
design.selectorHint: Leave empty to use form[action*="/cart/add"]. Only applies to product pages where the order table is shown.
design.previewDisabled: Enable an order table on a product first to preview.
design.advancedHelp: How to add the order table to your theme
overview.title: Overview
overview.placeholder: Tablely is being set up. The configuration pages arrive in the next build steps.

tables.shopDefaultHint: Applies to every product that doesn't set its own minimum. Leave blank for no minimum.

drawer.rulesHint: Set a minimum, maximum and step for each variant. Leave max blank for no limit.
drawer.saveAsTemplateHint: Store this product's layout, columns, rules and minimum as a reusable template.

templates.overflow: {n} products were skipped (limit {limit} per run). Apply again to finish.

wholesale.title: Wholesale
wholesale.gateHint: Control what customers outside an approved group can see. Qualification is checked live against customer tags at render time.
wholesale.gateMode.off: Off — everyone sees tables and prices
wholesale.gateMode.hide_table: Hide the whole table from unapproved customers
wholesale.gateTagsHint: A logged-in customer with any of these tags stays qualified. Tags come from the customer groups below.
wholesale.gateTagsEmpty: No tags yet. Create a customer group below to get started.
wholesale.groupsHint: Each group maps to one Shopify customer tag. Wholesale prices are keyed by that tag.
wholesale.groupTagHint: Must match the tag on your customers exactly (no spaces).
wholesale.groupDeleteWarning: This group is used by {n} wholesale prices. Deleting it also removes those prices.
wholesale.tiersHint: Quantity breaks applied to the pre-discount unit price. Product-level tiers inherit the store tier model below.
wholesale.tierEnabledHint: Turn off to stop tier discounts everywhere without deleting your product tiers.
wholesale.tierNoProducts: No product has an order table yet. Enable one under Tables first.
wholesale.pricesHint: Set a per-variant price for a customer group. Leave a field empty to remove that price.
wholesale.priceNoGroups: Create a customer group first — wholesale prices are keyed by its tag.
wholesale.priceNoProducts: No product has an order table yet. Enable one under Tables first.
wholesale.priceHint: Variant prices override tier pricing for customers in this group.
wholesale.mixHint: Group variants so customers can combine them to unlock a bundle discount.
wholesale.mixDeleteWarning: This bundle has {n} member variants. Deleting it removes the whole bundle.
wholesale.mixNoGroups: Create a bundle above to get started.
wholesale.mixNoProducts: No product has an order table yet. Enable one under Tables first.
wholesale.mixPriority: Only variants explicitly added to a bundle count toward its total.
empty.groups.title: Create your first customer group
empty.groups.body: Group buyers by a customer tag so you can give each group its own wholesale prices.
empty.prices.title: No wholesale prices yet
empty.prices.body: Give customer groups their own per-variant prices. Create a customer group, then pick a product to set prices.
empty.tiers.title: No tier pricing yet
empty.tiers.body: Set quantity breaks so the unit price drops as customers order more.
empty.mixmatch.title: No Mix & Match bundles yet
empty.mixmatch.body: Let customers combine products to unlock a bundle discount.
empty.applications.title: No wholesale applications yet
empty.applications.body: Add the application form link to your store navigation.
